title: Stateless GPU particle fountain
purpose: Run thousands of looping particles in three.js with no per-frame buffer updates: the vertex stage computes each particle from its seed and birth attributes and the time (cone launch, speed, spawn disc, gravity, swirl, size and fade over life) with integer-hash randoms that an exact CPU mirror reproduces.

engine.name: webgl2_browser
engine.notes: three.js r155 or later passed in as THREE (GLSL ES 3.00 uint arithmetic; the fragment stage includes the colorspace_fragment chunk); only 0.186.1 was run.

contract.language: ECMAScript 2020 module; GLSL ES 3.00 through three.js ShaderMaterial

exports.name: createParticlePoints
exports.summary: The geometry and the material in one Points object; set material.uniforms.uTime.value every frame.

exports.name: createParticleGeometry
exports.summary: count particles: a zero position attribute, aSeed = index, aBirth, and a bounding sphere that holds every path.

exports.name: particleState
exports.signature: particleState(index, time, options = {}) -> {position, life, size, alpha, cycle}
exports.summary: CPU mirror of the vertex stage for one particle.

exports.name: particleBirth
exports.summary: fract(index * golden ratio) * lifetime, rounded to float32 as the attribute stores it.

exports.name: PARTICLE_GLSL
exports.summary: GLSL particlePcg, particleRandom, vec4 particleState(float seed, float birth, float time) and particleAlpha(float life).

exports.name: PARTICLE_VERTEX
exports.summary: Points vertex stage with distance-attenuated size.

exports.name: PARTICLE_FRAGMENT
exports.summary: Soft round sprite coloured over life.

options.name: coneAngle
options.meaning: Half angle of the launch cone around +Y; directions are uniform over the cap.

options.name: swirl
options.meaning: Rotation of each particle's position about the Y axis with age.

options.name: emitterRadius
options.meaning: Spawn points are uniform over a disc of this radius on y = 0.

options.name: endSize
options.meaning: Size at the end of life.

options.name: fadeIn
options.meaning: Fraction of life spent fading in.

options.name: fadeOut
options.meaning: Fraction of life spent fading out.

options.name: endColor
options.meaning: Colour at the end of life.

options.name: pointScale
options.meaning: Drawing-buffer height / (2 tan(fov / 2)), so sizes are in world units.

limits: Particles are stateless, so nothing can collide, react to the scene, be spawned at an event or change course mid-flight; motion is a closed form of time (ballistic flight plus a swirl about the Y axis). Particles are not sorted; additive blending hides that, other blending would show it. Size uses gl_PointSize, which WebGL caps at an implementation limit (often 64 to 1024 pixels). GPU and CPU agree within float32 error except at the instant a particle loops, where float32 rounding can put it in the next loop. Only three.js 0.186.1 was run, in headless Chrome on SwiftShader WebGL 2; frame time was not measured.
technique_references: Stateless particle evaluation from seed, birth time and a time uniform
PCG-style integer hash for per-loop random numbers
Uniform directions on a spherical cap from a uniform cosine
